layout_description: Place paired observations and the unchanged mask at the left, converging on a two-level aggregation operator. The top continuation creates prespecified appearance strata. Beneath it, use an undirected association bracket to flag changing class proportions, explicitly avoiding a causal arrow from appearance to errors. Link the strata to background false-positive reporting, with IoU interpretation reserved for the caption.

RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render text ONLY within designated exact_* fields; all other prose is production guidance.
All container boxes use WHITE (#FFFFFF) fill with COLORED BORDERS ONLY; preserve native pixels inside real source-image assets.
Use title 10–12pt, primary label 8–9pt, secondary label 7–8pt and tensor notes 6–7pt; keep labels readable after final placement.
Use 1.5pt container borders and forward arrows, 1.0pt dividers and feedback arrows; align objects on a consistent grid.
Icons are monochrome dark-grey thin line art, one visual anchor per major block; no decorative pictograms.
Weight status uses a solid border with [训练] for trainable weights, a dashed grey border with [固定] for frozen weights; do not assign weight status to ordinary data.
Main forward flow arrows are SOLID; feedback arrows DASHED; optional-extension edges DOTTED. No held-out test feedback into development.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning icons, NO 3D rendering; no gradients, shadows, invented achievements or winner badges.
Use no more than three specified chromatic colors plus neutrals; source raster colors remain unchanged.
Long formulas, thresholds without frozen values, citations and explanatory sentences belong in caption_note, never in module boxes.
No fabricated measurements, ROC curves, confusion scores, geographic coordinates, model layers or environmental-risk categories.
This package is planning-only: do not execute image generation or plot rendering without the subsequent task to produce figures.
